Arrow of Death.description: At 10th level, an arcane archer can craft a specially prepared lethal arrow. If this arrow hits and deals damage, the target must succeed on a DC 20 Fortitude save or die instantly. Creating this arrow requires one full day of work, and only the arcane archer who crafted it can use it. The arrow remains potent for up to one year, and the archer can only maintain one such arrow at a time.

Enhance Arrow.description: Beginning at 1st level, any nonmagical arrow that an arcane archer fires is automatically treated as magical, receiving a +1 enhancement bonus. The archer does not need to expend gold or experience points to achieve this effect. These magically enhanced arrows only work when used by the arcane archer herself. For every two levels gained beyond 1st level in this prestige class, the enhancement bonus on her arrows increases by +1 (+1 at 1st level, +2 at 3rd level, +3 at 5th level, +4 at 7th level, and +5 at 9th level).

Hail of Arrows.description: At 8th level or higher, an arcane archer may once per day replace her normal attacks with a volley of arrows directed at multiple foes. She can target one enemy for each arcane archer level she possesses, provided each target is within range. Every attack in the volley uses her highest attack bonus, and no single enemy can be struck by more than one arrow from this volley.

Imbue Arrow.description: Starting at 2nd level, an arcane archer learns to channel an area spell through an arrow she fires. The spell's area of effect is centered where the arrow strikes, regardless of whether the spell would normally need to originate from the caster. This lets the archer take advantage of the bow's range instead of being limited by the spell's normal range. Casting the spell and firing the arrow together requires a standard action. If the arrow is not released during the same round the spell is cast, the spell is lost.

Phase Arrow.description: At 6th level, an arcane archer gains the ability to fire one arrow per day that passes through solid matter in a direct line toward a known target within range. The arrow travels straight to the target, phasing through any nonmagical walls or obstacles along the way. Magical barriers such as a wall of force or wall of fire will still block it. This effect ignores cover, concealment, and armor modifiers, but the attack is otherwise rolled normally. Using this ability requires a standard action, which includes releasing the arrow.

Seeker Arrow.description: Upon reaching 4th level, an arcane archer may fire a single arrow once per day at any target she is aware of within range. The arrow magically guides itself toward the target, navigating around obstacles and corners. Only a completely impassable barrier or exceeding the arrow's maximum range can stop it. This negates any cover or concealment modifiers the target might have, though the attack roll is otherwise resolved normally. Activating this ability is a standard action that includes firing the arrow.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: An arcane archer gains proficiency with all simple weapons, all martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields.

overrides.description: The arcane archer combines martial archery expertise with arcane magical ability, weaving spells into her ranged combat techniques.
